dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product stops the person for a decision it cannot make for them (discard a draft, delete an account, grant a permission) and collects a few details without leaving the page, in a surface that dims and blocks everything behind it and always offers an answer.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a dialog reads: the scrim behind it; the container's color, elevation, corner shape, padding, gap, minimum and maximum width and its margin to the window; the window width below which it sits at the bottom; the header (where the icon sits and its gap to the headline); the icon, headline, supporting text and content colors and text styles; the dividers shown while the content scrolls; how the actions are arranged, their default Button variant and their spacing; and the enter and exit motion, centred and from the bottom.
rules: Every dialog has at least one action. The actions are Tanrei Buttons, marked confirming or dismissive; the dialog places them as a full-width Button group and gives a Button without a variant the one comp.dialog.actions.variant names (tonal in the default system). It never changes a variant the product set.
Choose another look for every dialog of a product by re-valuing comp.dialog.actions.variant and comp.dialog.actions.arrangement in its layer; set a Button's variant for one action only.
Use the headline for a question or a statement of what will happen; it is the dialog's accessible name.
A dialog interrupts. Report an outcome with a snackbar and explain with a tooltip instead.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.

color.$description: The dim over everything behind the dialog, alpha included: the modal layer's, unless a system sets the dialog apart.

blur.$description: How much the scrim behind the dialog blurs what lies behind it: the modal layer's (0, none, in the default system).

shape.$description: Every corner of the container, centred or at the bottom of a compact window.

padding.$description: The inset of the header, text, content and actions from the container's edges, on every side.

gap.$description: Between the header, the supporting text and the content, top to bottom, and between the icon and the headline when the icon sits above it.

min-width.$description: The narrowest a dialog draws, unless the window less its margins is narrower.

max-width.$description: The widest a dialog draws, centred or at the bottom; longer text wraps and wider content scrolls or wraps.

margin.$description: The least distance between the container and the edges of the window's safe area (and the on-screen keyboard), centred or at the bottom. It wins over min-width on a narrow window.

window-width.$description: A window narrower than this is compact: the dialog sits at the bottom of it instead of its centre (DLG-17). 0 keeps the dialog centred in every window.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides below which window width its dialogs move within reach of the thumb, and a product whose dialogs stay centred everywhere sets 0.

gap.$description: Between the icon and the headline beside it, while the icon sits at the headline's start (icon.placement inline).

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product pairs a glyph with the words beside it more tightly than it spaces the stacked parts of a surface; the header's gap is that pairing, apart from container.gap.

placement.$description: Where the icon sits. inline: at the start of the headline's first line, header.gap before it, the headline and the supporting text aligned to the start. above: above the headline, container.gap apart, the icon and the headline centred and the supporting text at the start. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once, for all its dialogs, whether an icon marks the headline beside it or heads the dialog above it; the two read differently and a product picks one.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

color.$description: The foreground the dialog hands to its custom content (a list, a field's surroundings), as the platform's inherited color.

visibility.$description: When the dividers below the header and above the actions are drawn while the supporting text and the content scroll between them. always: both, whenever that part scrolls, wherever it is scrolled to. scroll: below the header only while the part is not at its top, above the actions only while more of it lies below (DLG-11). Under either choice none is drawn while everything fits. Follows the system's choice; the dividerVisibility prop overrides it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product rules its dialogs' fixed header and actions off from the part that scrolls between them for as long as it scrolls, while another shows each line only once content has passed it; a dialog may be set apart from the sheets beside it, because it is drawn over the page rather than in it.

gap.$description: Between two actions, in a row or stacked. At sys.target.touch minus the lowest Button (small, 32) or more, every action keeps its whole target in a column, as comp.button-group.standard.gap does.

margin-block-start.$description: Between the last of the header, text and content and the actions.

arrangement.$description: How the actions sit. fill: a full-width Button group, the actions sharing the container's inner width equally. end: at their own widths, aligned to the end. Either stacks into a column when the row does not fit (DLG-10). The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product decides once how the answers at the foot of its dialogs sit: as equal, full-width targets, or as a compact row at the end that leaves the width to the text.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

variant.$description: The Button variant the dialog gives an action whose variant the product did not set (DLG-20). An action whose variant is set keeps it. The value is an index into dev.tanrei.enum.values, the core Button variants; platforms receive the name.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product chooses the emphasis of its dialogs' answers once, for every dialog, rather than on each Button: tonal where the answers are the dialog's point, text where the words should lead.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A choice of kind; no dial scales it.

enter-scale.$description: The size a centred container grows from, as a fraction of its own, while it fades in. 1 fades without growing.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A proportion of the dialog's own size; no dial scales it.

enter-offset.$description: How far below its place a container at the bottom of a compact window starts as it rises in, and sinks as it leaves. 0 fades without moving.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product tunes how far a dialog travels when it comes up from the bottom edge: far enough to say where it came from, short enough not to read as a sheet.
